full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph shows a wet city road running beneath a vast suspension bridge into fog. The camera stands low near the curb, looking along the road toward a bright, nearly white vanishing point. At the far left, a dark building wall rises out of frame, its edge a strong vertical black mass. The bridge enters from the upper right, its underside forming a broad diagonal roof that descends toward the center distance. A tall openwork support tower is visible left of the bridge deck, with crisscross steel beams and an arched void, while another support appears deeper under the span. Thin cables drop from the deck into the pale fog. The roadway occupies most of the lower half, its uneven wet surface broken into bright white reflections and black patches. Streetlights bloom along both sides: one near the left foreground is a bright circle, and another hangs to the right beneath the bridge. Their light stretches into long shimmering columns across the pavement. Several old boxy automobiles and trucks stand or move along the right side and middle distance, rendered as dark silhouettes with occasional pale windows. A few small pedestrians appear near the left curb and beside the vehicles, reduced by scale and haze. The bridge and buildings disappear gradually into the gray atmosphere rather than ending at a clear horizon. Strong backlight from the distant fog flattens the furthest forms, while nearby vehicles and structural beams retain crisp black edges. The photograph has visible grain and rich silver midtones between glowing white and dense shadow. The composition gives the bridge extraordinary overhead weight and the glistening roadway an equally strong pull inward, producing a dramatic urban corridor of steel, rain, mist, and reflected light.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形黑白街头照片呈现一条潮湿城市道路，在巨大悬索桥下通向雾里。相机位置靠近路沿且偏低，沿路看向近乎白色的明亮消失点。最左边一面深暗建筑墙升出画外，边缘成为有力的竖向黑块。桥从右上进入，下腹形成宽阔斜向顶盖，朝中央远处下压。桥面左侧可见一座高高的镂空支撑塔，交叉钢梁和拱形空洞清楚；另一座支撑则出现在桥下更深处。细缆索从桥面垂入浅雾。路面占据下半幅大部，凹凸的湿表面碎成白亮反光和黑斑。街灯沿两边生出晕圈：左前景附近一盏是明亮圆点，桥下右侧还有一盏。它们的光在地面拉成长长的闪烁竖柱。几辆旧式方盒汽车与卡车停着或行驶在右侧及中景，呈深暗剪影，偶尔露出浅色车窗。几名小行人出现在左路沿及车辆旁，被尺度和雾气缩小。桥与建筑渐渐消入灰色空气，而非止于清楚地平线。远处雾中强逆光把最远形体压平，近处车辆与结构钢梁仍有清晰黑边。照片有可见颗粒，在白亮与浓影之间保留丰厚银灰中间调。构图让桥有非凡的头顶重量，也让发亮道路产生同样强烈的向内牵引，形成由钢、雨、雾与反光组成的戏剧性城市通道。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white photography organizes a low viewpoint with towering diagonal masses and a reflective plane that draws inward. Dense black silhouettes oppose luminous fog and small light halos; silver-gray midtones hold the intervening structure. Wet, irregular texture breaks bright reflections into elongated vertical fragments rather than smooth mirror bands. Near edges remain sharply graphic, then lose contrast with distance until fine lines dissolve into haze. Visible grain strengthens the tactile surface. A broad dark shape overhangs the upper composition, while scattered glowing points recede toward a pale center. The result is a monumental rhythm of heavy shadow, light-filled voids, and deep spatial pull.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影以低视点组织高耸斜向大块和把视线引向深处的反光平面。浓黑剪影对照发亮雾气与小光晕，银灰中间调保留两者间的结构。潮湿不规则肌理把亮反光打碎成拉长的竖向片段，而非光滑镜面带。近处边缘保持清楚图形性，随后随距离失去对比，细线最终溶入雾。可见颗粒加强可触表面。宽阔深色形态压住构图上方，散落发光点则朝浅色中心递退。最终形成沉重阴影、充光空隙与深远空间牵引的宏大节奏。
theme_en: A rain-glossed city street beneath a looming suspension bridge
theme_zh: 一条雨后发亮的城市街道位于高耸悬索桥下
name: Andreas Feininger
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
